name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Permanent Fumez
description:
Permanent Fumez delivers a deep, heavy leather-gas aroma, clean sharp, and unmistakably loud. Notes of burnt rubber and dark berries cut through the nose On the smoke, menthol comes forward with a rich, earthy backbone. The gassy fumes coat the palate, easing both mind and body into a calm, relaxed state.

Lineage: Permanent Marker x Gello Shotz

Effects: Heavy, Mind Easing, Relaxed

Flavors: Burnt Rubber, Dark Berries, Gas
